crossRefs.note: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.
crossRefs.keyword: a plague. i,e., "The plague of leprosy."

translations.web: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.
translations.bsb: If it spreads any further on the skin, the priest must pronounce him unclean; it is an infection.
translations.kjv: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
translations.asv: And if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
